rows.label: kintsugi
rows.description: Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with lacquer dusted or mixed with powdered gold, silver, or platinum
rows.hook: mends broken pottery with gold-dusted lacquer, so the cracks become the prettiest part

rows.label: geocaching
rows.hook: sends people hunting for hidden containers using GPS coordinates

rows.label: cosplay
rows.hook: has fans dressing up as their favorite characters from movies, games or comics

rows.label: bonsai
rows.hook: trains miniature trees into elegant shapes through careful pruning

rows.label: falconry
rows.description: hunting with a trained bird of prey
rows.hook: trains hawks and other birds of prey to hunt and return to a gloved hand

rows.label: origami
rows.description: traditional Japanese art of paper folding
rows.hook: folds a single flat sheet of paper into cranes and other figures, without cuts or glue

rows.label: live action role-playing game
rows.description: form of role-playing game where the participants physically act out their characters' actions
rows.hook: has players in costume act out a story in person, often fighting with foam swords

rows.label: calligraphy
rows.hook: turns handwriting into art with broad-nibbed pens and careful strokes

rows.label: taxidermy
rows.description: art of preparing dead animals to preserve them with the appearance of life
rows.hook: preserves and mounts dead animals so they look alive

rows.label: ikebana
rows.hook: is the Japanese art of arranging flowers, stems and branches

rows.label: crocheting
rows.description: technique of creating lace or fabric from thread using a hook
rows.hook: loops yarn with a single hooked needle to make blankets, hats and lace

rows.label: numismatics
rows.description: study of currencies, coins and paper money
rows.hook: is the study and collecting of coins and banknotes

rows.label: philately
rows.description: study of stamps and postal history and other related items
rows.hook: is the collecting and study of postage stamps

rows.label: vexillology
rows.hook: is the study of flags, their colours and what they mean

rows.label: macramé
rows.description: technique of knotting cords or thick yarns to make lace or fringe
rows.hook: ties cord into decorative knots to make plant hangers and wall hangings

rows.label: genealogy
rows.description: study of families, family history, and lineages using oral interviews, historical records, and genetic analysis; results displayed in charts or narratives demonstrating kinship and pedigrees among family members
rows.hook: traces family history back through records to build a family tree
